description:
Kim Yu-I, who has a minor taste and a fierce impression. Because of that, he always played music alone, but he ended up forming a band with his friend Min-Jun. One day, Yu-I meets Bae Yeong-Yeon, who says he fell in love with his performance at first sight, and he gradually opens his heart to Yeong-Yeon, who follows him around and helps him like a manager. And Yu-I, who had been worried about housing issues, ends up living in Yeong-Yeon's house, who has become a friend rather than a fan...?

A story of love blossoming quietly between a Born to be Locker and a Seong-Deok!

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)
